description: Pre-existing (present at 0cb890e95 and earlier; surfaced by the .18.28.3 removable-code audit). dnf.rs:1 module header mentions 'subsumption dedup' and dnf.rs:22 claims subsumption dedup 'runs as a post-pass at Descr::union' — no such pass exists anywhere in types/ (grep subsumption/clause-subsumes: nothing; Descr::union at descr.rs:388 has none). Either the pass was removed and the comments outlived it, or it was never built. WORK: delete/correct the comments to present-tense fact (agent-docs law); if subsumption dedup is actually WANTED (it would compound the .18.28.3 hygiene), that is a separate design decision — do not build it under this ticket.
title: Stale fz-et8 comment in dnf.rs describes a subsumption post-pass that does not exist
